entries.question: System modules and functions
entries.answer: This HRIS supports role-based dashboards; employee and account management; profiles and PDS; divisions, positions and signatories; service records and salary notices; leave applications and balances; leave monetization; travel orders; pass slips and QR scanning; compensatory time off and COC credits; overtime and accomplishment reports; attendance import and DTR; payroll preparation, approval, payout and payslips; MGB Coop loans; IPCR and OPCR performance; promotions; rewards, nominations, employee voting, loyalty awards and certificates; reports and analytics; calendars, holidays and announcements; messages and notifications; roles, permissions, audit logs, backups and security settings. The same module can show different records and actions for each role. Ask about a particular task for its procedure.

entries.question: Roles, permissions and approval responsibilities
entries.answer: Built-in portals are Admin, HR Head, HR Staff, Division Chief, Chief Admin, Planning Officer, Cashier, Regional Director and Employee. Admin manages master data, users, roles and settings. HR Staff maintains operational records and first-stage leave verification; HR Head performs HR review and management. Division Chiefs handle division-scoped reviews, performance and promotion preparation. Only the FAD/FAM Division Chief has the Chief payroll desk; Chief Admin does not inherit that payroll role. Planning Officers recommend travel orders and can perform configured division leave actions. The Regional Director handles final approvals and OPCR validation. Cashier handles payroll payout and personal request filing. Employees use their own records and requests. Custom roles inherit a configured base role and can have permission overrides; the custom Finance role uses an HR Head-based portal but is treated as a payout desk in payroll rather than an HR Head approver. Actual module/action permissions and workflow stage checks determine access; a role name alone does not grant every action. Messages and notifications are shared utilities.

entries.question: Dashboards, summaries and quick actions
entries.answer: Open Dashboard from your portal's sidebar. Dashboard content is scoped to the current role and may include employee profile details, leave credits, attendance, request counts, performance, payroll or division summaries. Employee quick actions include File Leave, View Attendance, View Payslip and Update Profile. Choose a period/filter on a chart where available and open the underlying module for the full records. Empty or loading cards do not establish that a record was deleted; review its module or retry a failed data load. Header controls provide theme switching, Help & FAQ, messages, notifications and your account menu.

entries.question: Employee management and employee directory
entries.answer: Open Employee Management or Employee Directory from a portal with employee permissions. Search and filter the list, then open an employee card for the available details. Authorized management users can add/edit employee information, assignment, employment status, date hired and salary-related master fields; complete required fields before saving. The employee form can include profile photos and supporting documents. A Division Chief's team view is scoped to their division. Employee records and user login accounts are related but distinct. Use the archive/restore actions when available rather than assuming an archive is permanent deletion. Import and export options are available where shown. Changing appointment-related position/salary fields can create service-record history, so review the employee and effective information before saving.

entries.question: Divisions, positions and organization structure
entries.answer: Use Divisions Management and Positions Management to maintain the organization catalog. A division groups employees and controls division-scoped reviews. A position is selected from the positions catalog and can have hierarchy/salary-grade information. The employee's optional designation is a separate assignment, such as an OIC title, and is not the same field as the position. Complete the applicable organization fields and save through the management screen. Unassigned employee division/position values can remain empty until an authorized user completes the record. Review dependencies before archiving catalog entries.

entries.question: Service records, imports and printable employment history
entries.answer: Open Service Record or My Service Record. Select the employee when your role manages other employees, then review dated appointment/history entries. Records include service dates, position/designation, employment status, station/branch, salary and grade/step fields where applicable. Authorized users can maintain and import service records using the available import dialog, review the extracted rows before saving, and print/download the service record. Employees use their own read-only history. Current appointment changes can append history; a service-history entry and today's employee master fields have different purposes. Do not assume an imported document has already been saved until its review/save action succeeds.

entries.question: Salary adjustments and salary/step increment notices
entries.answer: The admin workspace defines Salary Adjustment, Notice of Salary Adjustment and Notice of Step Increment views. Use the relevant salary/service-record view for the selected employee, review the grade, step, salary schedule and effective-date information supported by the form, and use its save/print/export controls. entries.question: All profile sections and saving changes
entries.answer: My Profile has Personal Details, Family Background, Educational Background, Civil Service Eligibility, Learning & Development, Address, Government IDs, Employment Status, Emergency Contact, E-Signature and Security. Edit Profile enables the available editable sections and Save Changes saves changed sections. Cancel restores unsaved drafts; the photo/PDS photo preference and verified email are saved separately and retained. A protected Personal Details section requires an approved edit request from Admin or HR Head when the role cannot edit directly. The family section supports spouse, parents and children; education is grouped by level. Eligibility allows up to 31 entries and learning/development up to 61; dates must be valid, training end cannot precede its start, and training hours must be non-negative with up to two decimal places. A failed section load stays read-only to protect existing records.

entries.question: Leave filing, review, approval and cancellation
entries.answer: File a leave request from the employee Leave Request page or the request workspace available to your role. Select type, dates and the required details; attach supporting material when required and submit. The standard approval chain is HR Staff credit verification (Pending to Endorsed), HR Head review (Reviewed), Division Chief review (Chief Reviewed), then Regional Director final approval (Approved). Planning Officers can perform configured division-desk actions when granted the corresponding leave approve/reject permission. The applicant's own role and division can cause documented stages to be skipped so an approver does not approve their own request. Review the current stage and available actions rather than applying the standard chain blindly. Rejections/cancellations and archiving have different effects. Personal-request roles are restricted to their own records.

entries.question: Leave types, eligibility, requirements and active status
entries.answer: Open Settings > Leave Types. Add or edit a type using the available name, eligibility, credit/limit and requirement fields, review its active status, and save. Active/inactive status controls whether a type is offered for new filing; existing requests retain their recorded type/history. Eligibility can depend on employee information such as gender and the type's configured rules. If a type is missing from a leave form, check both its active setting and the employee's eligibility rather than creating a duplicate type.

View, create, update, approve/reject and other actions can have different grants, and workflow stage/record scope can further restrict them. The access-denied screen can provide an access-request action. Submitting that request asks an authorized administrator to review access; it does not grant it immediately.

During login, use the emailed code and the displayed resend/expiry behavior. A required system rule cannot be bypassed by toggling an unrelated profile field. entries.question: Rate limiting, request filing limits and retry periods
entries.answer: Settings > Rate Limiting lets authorized administrators configure enabled limits, request counts, time windows and blocking periods for the supported groups. Groups include sign-in attempts, password-reset requests/codes, two-factor verification, shared request filing and general API traffic. The filing allowance is shared across request modules for the filing account, rather than resetting when switching from leave to travel or CTO. A rate-limited response provides a retry period; wait for it instead of repeatedly resubmitting. Changing global limits affects other users and should be done deliberately by an authorized administrator.

entries.question: Archives, missing records, validation and troubleshooting
entries.answer: If a record is missing, check employee/division/date/status filters and the archive toggle before assuming deletion. Archive/restore hides or returns records according to the module; it does not approve a request or reverse a financial workflow. A validation message means the relevant field/file/period needs correction before saving. A session-expired or inactive-account message requires the appropriate sign-in/account recovery, while Access Denied requires permission review. A page not found can be a wrong route or role portal. Preserve unsaved information when a save fails and retry the failed operation after its cause is resolved rather than duplicating the entire record.
keywords: Archives, missing records, validation and troubleshooting

entries.question: Help assistant, chat history, system guides and AI connection
entries.answer: The question-mark icon beside the header theme control opens Help & FAQ; on mobile it floats above the messages button. Ask a natural-language question about any documented system module or browse/search the system guides. The plus button starts a new chat. History lists your ten most recent completed conversations with titles and dates; reopen a chat to continue it or use its delete button to remove it. Chats are saved separately for each signed-in account in this browser, survive a reload, and do not sync to other browsers or devices. Clearing site storage removes local history. The assistant selects relevant module documentation and uses signed-in role/permission context for its guidance. It explains workflows and errors; it does not execute actions or access employee/payroll records. If NVIDIA is unavailable, it labels the matching built-in answer as System FAQ. The administrator configures the NVIDIA connection privately on the backend using NVIDIA_API_KEY and the model setting; never paste credentials into the help chat.
keywords: Help assistant, chat history, system guides and AI connection
